scope: EXT-D-0170 scoped source-only re-review of the native SEO driver sequence guard

prior_finding.detail: The new guard reads the actual exercisePanel callback and rejects swapped callbacks and outright removal of runSeoCaseSequence. It still accepts a driver that syntactically retains the call but skips it, or a controlled callback that returns before T14 and T02 execute.

verdict_a_native_readiness.evidence: Current source awaits runSeoCaseSequence directly in exercisePanel. The first callback runs controlled social-copy and changed-metadata recapture work; the second navigates to the Wikipedia detail source. The controlled DOM restoration remains in finally. The manual_source_stability assertion still marks T09 unverified and rethrows before exact manual-detail targets; the outer catch sets report.status to unverified and exitCode to 1.
verdict_a_native_readiness.limit: No native, browser, or build run was authorized. T02/T14 execution in a real browser and EXT-D-0169 product behavior remain unverified.

addressed: Swapping the two actual driver callbacks is rejected by the new source guard.
Replacing the actual direct sequence statement with an unrelated await is rejected.
Commit 9e7a9856 adds the new guard to package.json test:focused-acceptance, which both focused-acceptance.yml and ci.yml invoke.

findings.detail: The guard checks AST presence and call counts, not whether the driver reaches the sequence or whether the controlled callback reaches its work. In-memory mutants of the actual source that insert `return;` immediately before `await runSeoCaseSequence(...)` or at the start of the controlled callback both pass inspectDriverSequence. The latter skips T14/T02 while the Wikipedia callback still runs.
findings.impact: A real bypass or silent omission of the independent observations can pass the guard, so the prior forcing-function concern remains open for this class of failure.

verification.mutation: Executed inspectDriverSequence from the new test against the actual driver source and two in-memory early-return mutants: normal PASS, skip-controlled-callback PASS, skip-whole-sequence PASS.
verification.focused_ci_wiring: Confirmed 9e7a9856 adds tests/browser/seo-driver-sequence.test.mjs to the package.json focused command; both relevant workflows invoke that command. Root owns the full focused CI run.
